answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the prism of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the gale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
